# Session 1

From demand to design

## Main topics

- What are Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)?
- Service needs and technical requirements.
- Demand models and user density.
- Traffic estimation and quality-of-service targets.
- Network KPIs: capacity, latency, availability.
- Scenario types: urban, rural, industrial, mobility.


## What are NTNs?

::: {style="text-align:center;"}

*"An NTN is a wireless communication network that utilizes radio network equipment placed on an airborne or spaceborne vehicle"*



[@TripathiReed2025NTN]
:::

## Why NTN?

- Service in
  - Sparsely populated areas
  - Remote areas when base station deployment is not possible

## NTN use cases


![](assets/01_ntn_use_cases.svg)

::: notes
**Continuity: steering through a satelite** Scattered factories badly connected
with TN, workaround with NTN
**Continuity: Satellite transborder** Roaming accross countries with different
agreements in terms of TN.
**Continuity; Indirect connection through a 5G satellite access network** UE unable
to connect to NTN networks in remote areas (no TN coverage) may still connect to
non-NTN layers that act as access relays to the NTN network.

:::


## NTN Platforms

![NTN platforms (source: Ericsson)](assets/01_ntn_platforms.svg)

## NTN Platforms

| platform type  | altitude |
|:---------------|:--------:|
| Airborne (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles or UAV) | ~10km |
| High Altitude Platform System (HAPS)       | 20 km - 50 km |
| Satellite at Low Earth Orbit (LEO)         | 300 km - 3000 km |
| Satellite at Medium Earth Orbit (MEO)      | 6000 km - 8000 km |
| Satellite at Geostationary Orbit (GEO)     | ~36000km |

## 1. From Demand to Design: Use Case {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
**Example prompt**

Compare a dense urban district and a rural county.

**Expected student task**

- Estimate demand profiles.
- Define measurable KPIs.
- Separate hard requirements from assumptions.
- Explain why the two scenarios need different design targets.
:::
